name: path
title: Construct path to a file or directory

origin.description:
path() constructs a relative path, path_wd() constructs an absolute path
from the current working directory.

arguments.text:
character vectors, if any values are NA, the result will also be
NA. The paths follow the recycling rules used in the tibble package,
namely that only length 1 arguments are recycled.

arguments.name: ext
arguments.text: An optional extension to append to the generated path.
